ResearchArena Red-Team and Monitor Traces
	

Agent trajectories, artifacts, and monitor judgements from ResearchArena (paper), a control-evaluation framework that pairs an AI agent doing autonomous R&D with a malicious side task and charges a monitor with catching covert sabotage before deployment. The traces can be browsed at research-arena.ai/traces.

	
		
	
	
		Task
